architecture_verdict.summary: EMPIRICAL TEST VERDICT: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct averages 3,699.4ms (3.70s, p95=4.92s) per vision call, and Gemma 4 31B / Qwen 3.8 Max 27B / Claude Sonnet 5.5 average 5.0s–6.6s per vision call. Because wrestling tie-ups and shots transition in 0.8s–1.5s, 72B CANNOT analyze video in real time. Optimal Architecture: (1) Real-Time Live Stream Model = Local Hermes-3 8B + YOLOv8/MediaPipe 3D (56.2ms pose + 543.5ms coaching = 1.84 Hz live) paired with (2) Stronger Deep Clip Teacher = Top-rated Cloud VLM (Qwen2.5-VL-72B / Gemma 4 31B / Qwen 3.8 Max 27B) running on extracted 7-second MP4 clips.
